coverage.source_system: Methane leak detection (LDAR / OGI / satellite style)
Methane leak detection (LDAR / OGI / satellite style)

ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: PM tables via SLT, Openflow or a replication partner: IFLOT, EQUI/EQUZ/ILOA, QMEL/QMIH/QMFE/QMUR, AUFK/AFKO/AFIH, AFRU, PMCO, IMPTT/IMRG, MPLA/MPOS/MHIS, plus simulated IS-Oil well and downtime tables (OIUH_WC_WELL / OIUH_WC_DOWNTM).

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: PM tables as in ECC; actual order costs come from the Universal Journal ACDOCA. IS-Oil well and downtime tables are simulated (representative names).

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: PM InfoProviders: 0EQUIPMENT / 0FUNCT_LOC masters, order and notification ADSOs. No maintenance plans, measurement documents or IS-Oil volumes, so deferred production and PM compliance need ECC, S/4 or BDC.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: Equipment, FunctionalLocation, MaintenanceOrder, MaintenanceNotification, MeasuringPoint / MeasurementDocument, MaintenancePlan. BDC covers PM well, but has no IS-Oil data product (no wells, downtime or deferred volumes) and no order confirmations (actual hours).

HISTORIAN.name: Process historian (AVEVA PI style)
HISTORIAN.note: Tag catalog mapped to SAP equipment (SAP_EQUNR attribute), daily summaries for 24 months, hourly values for the last 45 days and HI / HIHI alarm events.

INSPECTIONS.name: Inspection & integrity (RBI style)
INSPECTIONS.note: Risk-based inspection plans and CML wall-thickness readings with corrosion rate and remaining life for pipelines, vessels and tanks, cross-referenced to SAP equipment.

LDAR.name: Methane LDAR (OGI / satellite / continuous)
LDAR.note: Leak surveys and detected leaks by facility (mapped to SAP functional locations) and component, with estimated rate, repair deadline, status and the SAP repair order.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
